title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 19
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 19: Joab's rebuke, David's return over the Jordan, and his dealings with Shimei, Mephibosheth and Barzillai.

questions.text: What did Joab urge the king to do?
questions.explanation: Joab said, "Arise, go out, and speak to comfort your servants."

answers.text: Pursue the rest of Absalom's men
Make Joab king in his place
Go out and speak to comfort his servants

questions.text: Where did the king sit when he arose?
questions.explanation: The king arose and sat in the gate, and all the people came before him.

answers.text: On his throne in the temple
At the fords of the Jordan
In the room over the gate

questions.text: Whom did David promise to make captain of the army instead of Joab?
questions.explanation: David said to tell Amasa he would be captain of the army before him continually instead of Joab.

questions.text: Where did Judah come to meet the king, to bring him over the Jordan?
questions.explanation: Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to bring the king over the Jordan.

questions.text: Who asked whether Shimei should be put to death for cursing Yahweh's anointed?
questions.explanation: Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered, "Shouldn't Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed Yahweh's anointed?"

questions.text: In what state did Mephibosheth come down to meet the king?
questions.explanation: From the day the king departed he had neither groomed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes.

answers.text: Dressed in a royal robe and a crown
Freshly washed and anointed with oil
With his beard untrimmed and his clothes unwashed
Riding in a chariot with fifty men

questions.text: What did the king decide about Mephibosheth and Ziba?
questions.explanation: The king said to Mephibosheth, "I say, you and Ziba divide the land."

answers.text: That Ziba should be put to death
That they should divide the land
That the land should go to the king

questions.explanation: Barzillai was a very aged man, even eighty years old.

questions.text: Whom did Barzillai send to go over with the king in his place?
questions.explanation: Barzillai said, "Behold, your servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king."

questions.text: What did the men of Israel say they had in the king?
questions.explanation: The men of Israel said, "We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more claim to David than you."
